Public-doc census (2026-11-18): the three English E6600 product pages link 299 unique EDOC ids and exactly 47 answer 200 - 38 videos, 8 Routine Maintenance chapters, the joint OSN 1800/E6600/DC908 web-UI guide (EDOC1100605035, whose 74,406-char text layer holds no TMB1, TMK1, TMK5 or TNG1, no Valid Slots, no Port Spec) and the EUCC statement.
